board: Ground: verified local resources, Boston, MA

checks.result: Confirmed on the provider page: Men's Inn at 444 Harrison Avenue, open 24/7 and 365 days a year, more than 330 guests each night, within shelters offering meals, showers, and laundry at some locations.
Confirmed on the provider page: breakfast and lunch every day of the year, breakfast 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and lunch 11:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., and the shelter at 39 Boylston Street.
Confirmed on the provider page: made from scratch meals six days a week at 23 Dartmouth Street, with breakfast, Friday afternoon, and Sunday meal times stated.
Confirmed on the provider page: food pantry for women and their families, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., at 887 Harrison Avenue, Boston, MA 02118.

Confirmed on the provider page: daytime and overnight shelters for women, an overnight shelter to housing program, and the address at 67 Newbury Street with Monday to Saturday hours of 7:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Confirmed on the provider page: three scratch made healthy meals daily for women, at 67 Newbury Street, with Monday to Saturday hours of 7:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Confirmed on the provider page: a shower program and toiletries at the day shelter at 39 Boylston Street; the page does not state shower hours.
Confirmed on the provider page: patients can visit the Jean Yawkey Place clinic at 780 Albany Street in Boston, and the page links a Sliding Fee Discount Policy; the page does not state clinic hours.

expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.
